name: AlphaSense
summary: Market intelligence platform searching 500M+ documents, with an AI analyst agent.
description: AlphaSense searches more than 500 million documents, including filings, broker research, expert call transcripts and news, for company and market research. Its SuperAnalyst agent works continuously on research tasks, and add-ins bring it into PowerPoint and Excel. Plans are arranged with the sales team; a free start option is offered, and no public prices are listed. Content partners and industry-specific coverage are listed on the site.
